mechanism: Vitamin C increases urinary uric acid excretion and may reduce allopurinol efficacy; high-dose vitamin C increases risk of xanthine/uric acid crystalluria and kidney stone formation in patients on allopurinol.
action: Monitor serum uric acid levels and renal function; advise patients to maintain adequate hydration and limit vitamin C supplementation to recommended daily allowance (RDA); avoid high-dose vitamin C (>2000 mg/day) in allopurinol-treated patients.
